info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Refund Submit-spec
info.description: The Refund Submission API facilitates the submission of refund requests for processed transactions. It allows financial service providers to efficiently handle refund submissions by supplying a unique refundId. This API is designed for use by payment processors, customer support teams, and accounting systems needing to manage refunds seamlessly. By automating the refund submission process, organizations can enhance operational efficiency and improve customer satisfaction.

post.summary: Submit a refund request for a specific reservation.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to submit a refund request for the reservation identified by the provided reservation ID. Make sure to provide all necessary details required for processing the refund.

requestBody.description: Submit a request for refund for the specified resource (RES-100045). This request should include the necessary details as per the schema defined for refunds.

200.description: The refund request was processed successfully.
